description: Source code for the NotePreviewWidget class, a Qt widget that displays and manages note previews with image handling, resizing, and resource loading.

classes.name: NotePreviewWidget
classes.description: A Qt widget derived from QTextBrowser for previewing notes with image resource management and dynamic resizing.

methods.name: resizeEvent
methods.description: Handles resize events to adjust image widths in the preview.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Loads image resources, resolving URLs to local paths.

methods.name: getUrlImageByPath
methods.description: Retrieves a UrlImage object by its file path.

methods.name: getUrlImageByUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a UrlImage object by its URL.

methods.name: insertUrlImageToList
methods.description: Adds or updates a UrlImage in the internal list.

methods.name: insertUrlImageToList (overload)
methods.description: Creates a UrlImage from URL and path, then inserts it into the list.

methods.name: changeImageWidth
methods.description: Adjusts image widths in the HTML content based on widget size.

methods.name: downloadThreadStarted
methods.description: Thread function to download images and update their sizes.

methods.name: setDisplayHtml
methods.description: Sets HTML content and initializes image list.

methods.name: initUrlImageList
methods.description: Parses HTML to find image URLs and starts image download thread.
